products.summary: The rugged compact most snorkelers and divers pick for still photos: a bright f/2.0 lens, RAW capture, an underwater white-balance preset and a Microscope mode that focuses 0.4 in from the glass, all waterproof to 50 ft with no case.
products.fit: Snorkelers and shallow divers who want sharp photos of fish, coral and tiny reef life, and a camera that also survives hikes, beaches and kids.
caveats: Small 1/2.3-inch sensor: noisy below 20 ft or in murky water without a light.
Battery is rated for about 330 shots and drains fast with GPS on or in cold water; carry a spare.
Cannot shoot while charging over USB-C.
Video is behind GoPro and DJI action cameras; 4K tops out at 30 fps.
Screen is not touch-sensitive and is hard to read in direct sun.
Scuba past 50 ft needs the optional PT-059 housing.
